name: Claude for Financial Advisors
description: Ready-to-run workflows for financial advisors in Claude Cowork, drawing live data from the tools their firm already uses through third-party connectors. The plugin holds no client data, and the advisor approves any write back to an external system. Claude gathers, organizes, summarizes, compares and presents information, while the advisor exercises judgment, makes the recommendation and gives the advice. For financial professional use only; not investment, legal, or tax advice.
longDescription:
Ships **8 skills**, **6 agents** and **23 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (8): `alts-brief` (Prepare a meeting-ready alternative-investments brief for a client, household, IRA, trust, or named account before a review —…), `compliance` (Review any client-facing message or material (emails, letters, newsletters, social posts, website copy, presentations, performance reports, proposals) for…), `estate-and-tax-brief` (Prepare a meeting-ready estate and tax brief for a household — opens with what was discussed and actioned…), `onboarding` (Welcome and set up a new Claude for Financial Advisors user), `portfolio-rebalance-review` (Run a portfolio review for a client or household — performance pulled from Orion, allocation drift analysis vs), `post-meeting` (Turn a client meeting into next-best-action follow-up for a financial advisor — no drafting required), `pre-meeting` (Prepare a complete client review meeting prep document for a financial advisor, for whatever timeframe the review covers…), `prospect-intake` (Start a new prospect's intake, with or without their files in hand — a request naming a new…)
- **Agents** (6): `compliance-lookup` (Check one thing against one connected system on behalf of the compliance skill — who a testimonial's author…), `compliance-scan` (Scan one piece of client-facing content against the Marketing Rule's seven general prohibitions and the specific content rules…), `holdings-sanity` (Run the seven data-sanity checks over one household's holdings and performance data before any drift or tax figure…), `source-extract` (Pull one system's data for one already-identified household and return it as a filled field schema), `statement-extract` (Read one account statement, export, or screenshot and return its accounts and holdings as a normalized record, with…), `titling-compare` (Compare what a household's estate plan intends against how its accounts are actually titled and beneficiaried, row by…)
- **MCP servers** (23): `orion-advisor-solutions`, `wealth-com`, `wealthbox`, `addepar`, `tamarac`, `zocks`, `icapital`, `moneyguide`, and 15 more

Installs with `claude plugin install claude-for-financial-advisors@knowledge-work-plugins` from `anthropics/financial-services` (`claude-for-financial-advisors`).
